description:
v1.0 | 77 gates | 3 ticks
https://github.com/byggmesterPRO/pareto-circuits

Sends one data input to one of 64 lines.

Use this to send one signal to one of several destinations chosen by a number, such as delivering a pulse to one of many doors or lamps, or writing a value into one of several memory cells.

The signal goes into the first input. The number that picks the destination follows it, with its lowest value input first. The chosen output carries the signal, and all other outputs stay off.

Inputs (yellow gates, first row, lowest bit first): data = x 0, line number = x 1-6.
Outputs (green gates): a matrix of 8 per row, line 0 first, behind the inputs.

Profile: small, the build with the fewest gates for this size.
How it works: One wide gate per term: gates take any number of inputs, so no stages are needed.
Checked on every possible input in a simulator. Gates include the input gates; ticks count the input gate too.
